description: List the one-shot wake-up calls of your wake-up-calls plan (wkp_...), up to 200, earliest first, finished ones too (keep wakeup_schedule's id for wakeup_cancel). Status: scheduled, retrying (a try failed and the next one is coming), firing, fired, failed or canceled. Works after the plan ended. Repeating ones: schedule_list.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: wakeup_list
title: List my wake-up calls
